main_text.p: venire audiuisset à Persarum rege legatos Byzan-tium, in vrbem rediit regiam. Tertia verò post die Celtiberiæ eodem quoq; Legati veniunt. Legatis nomina erant Bofo ac Betto, quos princeps gentis (Franci hi recentiore lingua vocantur. at illi nomen Theodoricho) ad Imperatorem misit, promisitq;, sc,si[?] vectigalia sibi darentur, opitulaturum Romanis, ac pro muneribus cum Chagano gesturum bellum. Imperator tamen muneratus legatos, si sua auxilia subpeditarent Franci, vt id gratis facerent iussit, nequaquam emi passus à Romanis opem barbarorum. Interim Chaganus ad priora pacta additamentum ab Imperatore flagitat, in qua re barbarus non auditus, statim restaurauit bellum.

Qvod Prifcus quindecim valla metatus, traiecto Istro fluuio, quarta die superiores Nobas venit. quod cum refcifceret Chaganus, ad Prifcum legatos misit, caufamque scire voluit aduentus Romanorum. Refpondit dux, ad venationem & aequitatum esse loca idonea, & aquosa satis: cui Chaganus oftendit alienam terram calcare Romanos, citraque pactum agere Priscum, & aperte pacem ab eo conuelli. Refpondet Priicus[?], Romanum quoque tu subis solum. Chaganus, armis, inquit, & iure belli. Romanos hoc amisisse. Chagano amplius rixante & difceptante de his locis, Priscum fugam ex oriente exprobrasse dicunt Chagano. page.notes: Left margin: only cropped fragments of marginal notes remain along the left edge (about a dozen short fragments, e.g. at the heights of the first, second and sixth lines); they are too cut off to read and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "sc,si" (possibly "fc,fi"), "Celtiberiæ", "Priicus" (apparent printing error for Priscus, left as printed), "traiecto" (the "ct" ligature is partly obscured). Catchword "stola" is only partly legible, read from "stcla" at the foot right. Heading "XIII." is a bare number and is therefore a paragraph, not a heading. The text ends with a hyphenated word "epi-", continued on the next page.
